objective: Build the missing bottom-up bridge from calibrated robot observations to persistent tracks and an atomic, conservative planning scene.

request_interpretation.curriculum_intent: Continue after camera geometry and before motion planning's assumed collision-scene snapshot.
request_interpretation.content_intent: Use a private transfer problem to force coverage of observation, temporal identity, probabilistic free space, dynamic layers, uncertainty, and planner handoff.
request_interpretation.visual_intent: Use measurable interactive evidence, semantic color, restrained line weight, stable dimensions, and mobile compositions rather than scaled desktop diagrams.
request_interpretation.provenance_intent: Store why each section exists, the primary source supporting it, and what that source does not establish.
request_interpretation.small_model_intent: Persist artifact boundaries, decisions, defects, and verification so 4B-9B models can replay bounded passes without reconstructing hidden context.

existing_coverage: robot-ai-top-down names detection, segmentation, fitting, outliers, and tracking at overview depth
robot-camera-geometry-calibration ends at one time-aligned metric observation
multiview-fusion covers generic feature fusion for classification
robot-motion-planning assumes a versioned collision scene already exists
gap_audit.scope_boundary: Detector backbone training, full SLAM, learned occupancy, and full TSDF implementation remain independent articles.

source_decisions.boundary: A mask score is not 3D occupancy probability or persistent identity.
Image-space MOT benchmarks and thresholds do not certify robot 3D tracking or collision safety.

source_decisions.source: Hornung et al., OctoMap, Autonomous Robots 2013
source_decisions.boundary: The paper uses mostly static laser/RGB-D datasets and does not solve semantic tracking, dynamic-object lifecycle, or modern PlanningScene concurrency.

source_decisions.source: MoveIt Rolling Planning Scene Monitor and moveit_msgs
source_decisions.boundary: Application-level atomic versioning, covariance, freshness, and provenance still need explicit policy.
The message does not validate units, color-depth registration, invalid-depth policy, or object identity.
Surface reconstruction is not identical to explicit planner free/unknown occupancy.

private_transfer_gate.scenario: Wrist RGB-D camera, overlapping mugs, partial hand occlusion, glossy invalid depth, mixed boundary pixels, robot self-points, motion, one miss, low-score return, and concurrent planning-scene update.
private_transfer_gate.publication_policy: Keep the integrated problem private; expose every needed insight as derivation, Viz, or operational gate.

implementation_decisions: Order nine sections by the physical state-construction path rather than by model family.
Use model-output capability comparison before presenting any algorithm so the evidence boundary is explicit.
Combine valid mask pixels into a 3D support set and preserve support count, contamination, covariance, frame, and time instead of using a box-center depth.
Separate high-score new-object creation from low-score recovery of existing tracks; never let every low-score box create an object.
Compare point cloud, TSDF, occupancy, and object tracks by planner query rather than calling one representation universally best.
Use ray clearing, bounded log odds, static/dynamic layers, and scene-version invalidation as distinct operational policies.
Use red only for violated invariants; use blue for observation/identity, emerald for accepted/free, amber for uncertainty, violet for probabilistic state.
Keep dense labels in responsive HTML and use SVG only where spatial geometry adds explanatory value.
Put Korean semantic labels directly inside article-specific LaTeX and let the shared registry recognize explicit annotated formulas.
Reconstruct OctoMap as prior bottleneck, author intent, mechanism, equations, evidence, assumptions, reproduction, failure, and legacy rather than a summary.

repair_log.defect: Long Korean underbrace formulas reached the global 0.52 minimum scale on 360-390 px screens.
repair_log.diagnosis: Zero document overflow hid a readability failure; one display combined several semantic operations into a single wide row.
repair_log.repair: Split mask-depth support, Mahalanobis distance, assignment, inverse sensor, log-odds, clamping, uncertainty margin, and scene gate into aligned derivation rows.
repair_log.verification: Concept minimum scale improved from 0.52 to 0.78 at 360 and 0.87 at 390; paper minimum improved to 0.77 and 0.86.

repair_log.defect: Track lifecycle used a 560 px minimum-width timeline with horizontal scrolling on phones.
repair_log.diagnosis: The six temporal samples are discrete and can wrap without losing order.
repair_log.repair: Changed mobile layout to a stable 3x2 grid and desktop to six columns.
repair_log.verification: No overflowing non-KaTeX elements and no document or internal timeline scroll at 360/390.

repair_log.defect: Korean metric values rendered as tofu boxes under Tailwind's default monospace stack.
repair_log.diagnosis: The global sans token had Noto Sans KR fallback but the mono token did not.
repair_log.repair: Defined a mono font token that preserves Latin monospace faces and falls back to Noto Sans KR Variable for CJK glyphs.
repair_log.verification: Mobile and desktop screenshots show 없음, 높음, 증거 부족, 정책 없음, and 매움 correctly.

repair_log.defect: The mobile 330x200 association SVG was scaled across the desktop article width, creating excessive whitespace and oversized marks.
repair_log.diagnosis: A single aspect ratio could not provide readable mobile labels and dense desktop trajectory framing.
repair_log.repair: Added a dedicated 700x240 desktop composition with recalculated path and object coordinates while keeping the mobile viewBox.
repair_log.verification: Desktop screenshot uses the width for crossing trajectories and keeps the metric ledger visible without a tall empty field.

repair_log.defect: Directly Korean-annotated formulas were reported missing because the global registry only accepted exact mapped source strings.
repair_log.diagnosis: Article-specific formulas already contained underbrace/overbrace text, so duplicating the full string in a central map was bookkeeping without added semantics.
repair_log.repair: The shared annotation resolver now accepts explicit brace-plus-text formulas as annotated while retaining registry rewrites for legacy raw equations.
repair_log.verification: Missing annotation count and KaTeX error count are zero on both pages at all four viewports.
